q: Aziz designs modern buildings and draws plans for new houses in Tashkent.
why: «Designs modern buildings» iborasi bu kasb arxitektor ekanligini bildiradi.

wrong.engineer: Muhandis asosan mexanizm va tuzilmalar bilan ishlaydi, bino loyihalashtirmaydi.
wrong.builder: Quruvchi loyihani chizmaydi, balki binoni quradi.
wrong.gardener: Bog'bon binolar bilan emas, o'simliklar bilan shug'ullanadi.

q: The office was very dirty, so the ______ cleaned the floors and desks.
why: «Cleaned the floors» so'zlari tozalovchi ishchiga ishora qiladi.

wrong.receptionist: Qabulxona xodimi pol yuvmaydi, balki mehmonlarni kutib oladi.
wrong.waiter: Ofitsiant restoranda xizmat ko'rsatadi, tozalash bilan shug'ullanmaydi.

q: As an ______, Jamshid designs and builds machines and bridges.
why: «Designs and builds machines» jumla muhandis kasbini bildiradi.

wrong.architect: Arxitektor mashinalar emas, faqat binolar loyihasini tuzadi.

q: He works hard on a large farm in Samarkand, growing wheat and vegetables.
why: «On a large farm» va sabzavot yetishtirish ferma ishchisiga mos keladi.

wrong.groundskeeper: Maydonlar bo'yicha ishchi sport maydonlarini parvarish qiladi.

q: I need to visit the ______ to get a new haircut before the wedding.
why: «New haircut» so'zi sartaroshga borish kerakligini bildiradi.

q: She gives first aid and drives the ambulance to the hospital very fast.
why: «First aid» va «ambulance» so'zlari tez yordam xodimiga ishora qiladi.

wrong.dentist: Tish shifokori tez yordam mashinasida yurmaydi.
wrong.police officer: Politsiyachi birinchi tibbiy yordam ko'rsatishga ixtisoslashmagan.

q: The ______ flies large airplanes to foreign countries every week.
why: «Flies large airplanes» jumla uchuvchi kasbini bildiradi.

q: He writes computer code and creates new mobile applications all day.
why: «Computer code» va «mobile applications» dasturchiga tegishli.

q: When you enter the hotel, the ______ welcomes you and gives your room key.
why: «Welcomes you and gives your room key» qabulxona xodimining vazifasi.

wrong.cleaner: Tozalovchi kalit bermaydi va mehmon kutib olmaydi.

q: She helps customers find the right clothes and takes their money at the shop.
why: «Helps customers find clothes» bu do'kon sotuvchisining ishi.

wrong.waiter: Ofitsiant kiyim sotmaydi, ovqat olib keladi.
wrong.receptionist: Qabulxona xodimi do'konda kiyim sotish bilan shug'ullanmaydi.

q: If you have legal problems, you should talk to a ______.
why: «Legal problems» huquqshunos yoki yurist yordamini talab qiladi.

wrong.dentist: Tish shifokori qonuniy masalalarni hal qilmaydi.

q: He trains the football team every evening to help them win the match.
why: «Trains the football team» futbol murabbiyini bildiradi.

wrong.farm worker: Ferma ishchisi sport jamoasiga murabbiylik qilmaydi.

q: We booked our summer holiday in Turkey with the help of a ______.
why: «Booked our summer holiday» sayyohlik agenti orqali amalga oshiriladi.

wrong.receptionist: Qabulxona xodimi faqat o'z mehmonxonasi uchun ishlaydi.
wrong.estate agent: Rieltor sayohatni emas, uy-joy sotishni tashkil qiladi.

q: She brings food and drinks to our table at the restaurant.
why: «Brings food and drinks to our table» ofitsiantning vazifasi.

wrong.cleaner: Tozalovchi restoranda ovqat tashiydi degani emas.

q: Painting and writing stories are very ______ jobs because you make new things.
why: «Make new things» ijodiy ishlarga xos xususiyatdir.

wrong.repetitive: Zerikarli bir xildagi ish ijodiy bo'la olmaydi.
wrong.tiring: Charchatuvchi so'zi yaratish jarayonini to'liq ochib bermaydi.
wrong.stressful: Stressli so'zi ijodkorlikni emas, qiyin bosimni bildiradi.

q: Doing the exact same factory task every single minute feels very ______.
why: «Exact same factory task» bir xilda takrorlanuvchi ishni bildiradi.

wrong.creative: Bir xil ish ijodiy bo'la olmaydi.
wrong.varied: Har xil ma'nosini beruvchi so'z bir xillikka mos kelmaydi.
wrong.rewarding: Foydali yoki quvonchli ish bir xil zerikarli ishga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

q: Teaching poor children and seeing them smile makes me feel so happy and fulfilled.
why: «Makes me feel so happy and fulfilled» bu foydali va zavqli ish.

wrong.tiring: Charchatuvchi so'zi bu yerda ijobiy tuyg'uni bildirmaydi.
wrong.repetitive: Takrorlanuvchi ish quvonch olib kelishini anglatmaydi.

q: Working as an air traffic controller is very ______ because one mistake can cause a disaster.
why: «One mistake can cause a disaster» bu ishning juda asabiy ekanligini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.rewarding: Xavfli vaziyat mukofotli emas, balki stressli bo'ladi.
wrong.varied: Har xil ma'nosi xavf va mas'uliyatni tushuntirmaydi.
wrong.creative: Ijodiy so'zi xavfli mas'uliyatga mos kelmaydi.

q: After carrying heavy boxes all day long, my legs and arms hurt and I just want to sleep.
why: «Legs and arms hurt and I just want to sleep» bu charchatuvchi ish.

wrong.rewarding: Og'riq va charchoq mukofotli his-tuyg'uni bildirmaydi.
wrong.varied: Har xil so'zi jismoniy charchoqni tushuntirmaydi.

q: My job is very ______ because every day I do different tasks and meet new people.
why: «Every day I do different tasks» bu ishning turfa xilligini ko'rsatadi.

wrong.repetitive: Har xil vazifalar bajariladigan ish takrorlanuvchi bo'la olmaydi.
wrong.stressful: Turfa vazifalar har doim ham stressli emas.
wrong.tiring: Charchatuvchi so'zi turli xil vazifalarni bajarish ma'nosini bermaydi.
